senses.gloss:
(ऋ) गाधृ r. 1st cl. (गधते)
1 To stand, to stay, to remain.
2 To seek, to search or inquire for.
3 To compile, string or heap together.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Not very deep.
m. (-धः)
1 Place, site.
2 Desire of gain, cupidity, covetousness.
3 Bottom, soundings.
E.
गाध to stand, &c. affix अच्.

m. (-धिः)
The name of a king, sovereign of Kanyakubja, father of VIŚVĀMITRA.

m. (-जः)
1 A name of the celebrated saint VIŚVĀMITRA.
E.
गाधि as above, and ज born.

n. (-रं)
Kanyakubja the ancient Kanouj.
E.
गाधि a proper name, and पुर a city; the capital of GĀDHI.

m. (-भूः)
The saint VIŚVĀMITRA.
E.
गाधि, and भू born, the son of GĀDHI.

m. (-यः)
VIŚVĀMITRA.
E.
गाधि, and ढक् patronymick affix: see the preceding.
